entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the exact supplied 128x128 technical RPG bag icon. Refine only restrained fine surface detail on the existing white hard shell, blue seams and rim. Preserve the same shape, silhouette, outlines, all panels and straps, circular emblem, highlighted red pocket segment, original colors, lighting and drop shadow. Every original feature stays at the same relative coordinate. No new zip, stitching, logo, lines, pockets, seams, text, symbols or highlights. Keep the original pixel-art identity and orientation. No crop, zoom, changed margins or rearrangement. Preserve transparent regions. Output a larger square detail proposal aligned to the complete original canvas; original structural identity has priority.
